items.titleZh: 福布斯：Mercor在谈200亿美元估值，创始人身价页尚未改
items.titleEn: Forbes: Mercor is in talks at $20 billion, but founder profiles have not moved
items.summaryZh: 若成交，三人或到每人约43亿美元；今天福布斯实时页仍按100亿美元估每人22亿美元。
items.summaryEn: If the round closes, each founder could be worth about $4.3 billion; today’s Forbes realtime pages still use $2.2 billion on a $10 billion company.

items.titleZh: 福布斯2026全球亿万富豪榜发布，快照日是3月1日

items.summaryEn: The official census is yearly; the realtime page is separate, and private-company fortunes often sit still.
